    {"decision_id":"7e4e10e6fc4db0effec2-0","relevant":0,"confidence":"high","reason":"這是 Kali 的登入稽核工具；追加選項用於日誌，沒有 sudo 追加所選文字的範例。","evidence":"-O [FILE] : File to append log information to"},

    {"decision_id":"3ffe68b6c2c8e19fb5c7-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"Ubuntu 文件示範用 sudo 執行 tee -a，把文字追加到本機設定檔。","evidence":"echo \"ServerSignature Off\" | sudo tee -a /etc/apache2/conf-available/zz-no-banner.conf"},

    {"decision_id":"c504de960916801cabe4-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"Ubuntu 範例用 sudo tee -a 將指定文字追加到既有檔案，保留先前內容。","evidence":"echo \"ServerSignature Off\" | sudo tee -a /etc/apache2/conf-available/zz-no-banner.conf"},

    {"decision_id":"11b3a56517f3575b62a0-0","relevant":1,"confidence":"high","reason":"下載範例記載可用覆寫選項，並示範在 sudo 情境下將遠端資料寫到指定本機路徑。","evidence":"Download This executable can download remote data. Comment Use --allow-overwrite if needed."},
